einzeiler: Three stories about hidden and unrecognized threats.
kurzfassung: This episode presents three distinct accounts involving unexpected dangers. The first story examines an unusual weather phenomenon at a summer camp. The second story follows an elderly woman who falls in her bathroom, and the third recounts a terrifying event on a train during World War II.
stichpunkte: An unusual weather phenomenon experienced at a summer camp
An elderly woman falling in her bathroom
A frightening situation unfolding on a train during WWII
